posts.zh:
dsh-md-preview 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 端可停靠的 Markdown 预览面板：与对话并排展示，会话级「最近打开 .md」列表，本地相对路径图片可直接渲染；点击对话中的 .md 引用改为并排预览而非唤起系统编辑器；跟随 shell 深浅色主题。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cb5291b99446a3bd3ba6.html
posts.en:
dsh-md-preview is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cb5291b99446a3bd3ba6.html
